mapper.select: SELECT location_id AS externalId, longitude AS lon, latitude AS lat FROM tb_selling_location WHERE ddt IS NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 ORDER BY location_id
SELECT location_id AS locationId, location_name AS shopName, address AS roadAddress FROM tb_selling_location WHERE ddt IS NULL AND location_id IN #{id}
